<thought>We have a single measurement between A and X1 of 6.667 Ω. The notes say the subnetwork has two resistors, one twice the other, labeled left‑to‑right as R1, R2. The simplest topology that matches “left‑to‑right” labeling is a series connection A‑R1‑intermediate‑R2‑X1. For series, total resistance = R1 + R2 = R + 2R = 3R = 6.667 Ω, giving R ≈ 2.222 Ω and 2R ≈ 4.445 Ω. This satisfies the measurement and the note about one resistor being twice the other. Hence the circuit topology is a series chain with those resistor values.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.222, "R2": 4.445}, "connections": [["A","N1","R1"], ["N1","X1","R2"]]}</final_answer>
